title: Canonical sections and polynomial restriction for a projective closed family
statement: Let $T,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $n\in\mathbf N$, $p:\mathbf P^n_T\to T$ the structural projection of the standard base-change projective space [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], and $i:Z\to\mathbf P^n_T$ any morphism (in particular, a closed-family inclusion). For $d\in\mathbf Z$, let $\mathcal O(d)$ be the standard twist [def-pc-projective-space-twist], pulled back from integral projective space, and define $\mathcal O_Z(d)=i^*\mathcal O(d)$ using the tensor pullback and its section-normalized adjunction [def-pc-module-pullback]. In the categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], define the ambient section sheaf $B_d=p_*\mathcal O(d)$ and the family section sheaf $E_d=(p\circ i)_*\mathcal O_Z(d)$, with direct image on an open $U\subseteq T$ given by sections on its inverse image. Define $\rho_{i,d}:B_d\to E_d$ as $p_*$ of the unit $\mathcal O(d)\to i_*i^*\mathcal O(d)$ followed by the canonical direct-image composition isomorphism. For $d\in\mathbf N$, let $A_{n,d}=\{(a_0,\ldots,a_n)\in\mathbf N^{n+1}:\sum a_j=d\}$ be the monomial index set [def-nagata-relative-projective-space], and define $V_d=\bigoplus_{a\in A_{n,d}}\mathcal O_T$. In the multivariate polynomial ring [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] over $\mathbf Z$, the integral monomial attached to $a$ is the degree-$d$ homogeneous component of $\prod_jx_j^{a_j}$. Its standard section of $\mathcal O(d)$ is transported from integral Proj to $\mathbf P^n_T$ by pullback. Define $\alpha_d:V_d\to B_d$ by sending the basis vector $a$ to this section; thus $\rho_{i,d}\alpha_d$ is the canonical polynomial-restriction map. These definitions impose no flatness, finite-presentation, Hilbert-polynomial or positivity hypothesis and assert no section bound, surjectivity, local freeness or base-change theorem. All schemes and coefficients lie in one fixed universe $u$, with the finite coordinate and monomial types lifted to that universe.

source.place: Tag 01XT (lemma-cohomology-projective-space-over-ring), preceding monomial notation and canonical homogeneous-polynomial sections; definition-projective-space and its standard twists.
